scope: Visual review of all three fresh screenshots from the rebuilt exported App UI font mode, after full-world readiness. This covers the visible typography and layout only, not combat, physical input, world fidelity or frame-rate claims.

images.review: 实际查看新 App 标题页。属于你的海港、我的悉尼、开始生活、自由沙盒、从悉尼机场起飞、存档与恢复、操作与设置等中文完整，箭头与中英文组合正常，v0.1.8 可见；主要可见按钮均未截字。制作与资料来源仅部分进入当前滚动窗口，属于该截图的滚动位置，不据此声称该行已完整可见。
images.inspection_method: tools.view_image; each new PNG was opened and visually inspected

images.review: 实际查看新 App 滚动后的载具菜单。Harbour Bastion · 无敌坦克 · 免费驾驶 与 Aster F-27 · 无敌战斗机 · 免费驾驶 两行均完整，敌字明确有正常笔画，没有缺字框；两按钮均在滚动窗口内，上下和右侧有余量。其余当前可见载具中文与拉丁名称清晰，没有相互覆盖。推荐此图作为缺字修复的主要展示图。
images.inspection_method: tools.view_image; each new PNG was opened and visually inspected

images.review: 实际查看新 App 地图界面。悉尼 · 地图与目的地、操作说明、海港与城市核心、机场 ↔ 海港 ↔ Manly 全图、Manly 码头与海滩、返回游戏 × 等中文及符号完整。右侧地图标题、比例尺和图例正常；市中心地名在当前全景缩放下较密，有部分文字重叠，不能由此图宣称所有地图标签排布都已优化。
images.inspection_method: tools.view_image; each new PNG was opened and visually inspected

limitations: Only the visible text and layouts in these three 1440x900 images were visually judged; the compiled runtime report separately covers its stated glyph checks.
Map labels remain dense and partly overlap at the pictured overview zoom; this is not a missing-glyph blocker.
The title image was taken after full-world readiness, not during initial import/loading.
UI font QA uses direct menu handlers and scroll positioning; it does not demonstrate physical mouse or keyboard operation.
